description:
National price index data for the German apartment building market. Source: vdp.

Quarterly data for apartment buildings (rental buildings, "Mehrfamilienhäuser") across Germany.

Time filters:
- start/end: flexible date values (YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD)
- recent: number of most recent periods (quarters)

Response controls:
- limit, fields, include: "metadata"

Key response fields (German names):
- preisindex: Price index for German apartment buildings (base year = 100)
- preisindex_delta_1q: Absolute change in price index compared to previous quarter
- preisindex_delta_1j: Absolute change in price index compared to previous year

end.description: Ende des Zeitraums (YYYY, YYYY-MM oder YYYY-MM-DD)

recent.description: Anzahl der aktuellsten Perioden. Mutually exclusive mit start/end.

start.description: Beginn des Zeitraums (YYYY, YYYY-MM oder YYYY-MM-DD)
